sections.content: Defending a position means stating a claim, giving reasons and responding to an opposing view. Combine obligation, rights, consequence, justification and evaluation.

items.spanish: Creo que esta regla es necesaria porque protege a todos.
items.english: I think this rule is necessary because it protects everyone.

items.spanish: Aunque la regla sea incómoda, debemos respetarla.
items.english: Although the rule may be inconvenient, we must respect it.

items.spanish: Es importante que las normas sean justas.
items.english: It is important that rules are fair.

sections.content: A clear argument should say what you think, why you think it and what consequence or principle supports your position.
